name: AgentCompass
author: akiiwa-games
description: Classify work through Cindy's quick-text channel, route it with the built-in AgentCompass engine, read the tail of local Codex session logs for quota, start matched child tasks in the parent project directory with bypassPermissions (Claude) / full-access (Codex, Pi), and collect exact results.
whenToUse: Delegate independent work through AgentCompass from a Cindy Claude, Codex or Pi session.

tools.name: roll
tools.description: Classify the full task, unchanged, through Cindy's quick-text channel (one model request with no agent, tools, task or session, on the user's model quota; the answer is cached for 10 minutes), then route it with the built-in AgentCompass engine (or a configured AgentCompass CLI, which classifies itself) over this Cindy's live model catalog and start one exact catalog route. Reads the tail of local Codex session logs (~/.codex and Cindy's codex-home) for quota, and creates the child task in the parent's project directory with bypassPermissions (Claude) or full-access (Codex, Pi) regardless of the parent session's own mode. split and self answers start no task, though the classification has used quota. A failed classification answers blocked and says what to change. Requires experimental tasks capabilities and a matching configured plugin task directory. Returns an operation and a concrete status-tool call; no automatic callback. Never supply session_context yourself.

profile.description: Optional complete task profile (AgentCompass v0.6.0), used instead of the classifier. Every field in `required` must be given, `axis_demand` as an object with the integer levels 0-3 of divergence, coding, aesthetics and tool_operation; an incomplete profile, or one with a field of an older profile, is refused. Refused when a configured AgentCompass CLI routes.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Collect the same operation. Reads durable host runs and paged messages; saves full output on disk and returns the exact final message summary. Call it until the run is terminal and messages_complete is true, then cleanup. Unknown delivery is reconciled from host runs, never resent.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Cancel this plugin's run through Cindy's official scoped cancel API and wait briefly for the host to confirm. A run still reported as stopping is not terminated yet; collect status until terminal.

tools.name: cleanup
tools.description: Archive this plugin's task once every run on it is terminal and its messages are fully collected; otherwise refuse and name the tool to call. Without a host archive API, return the confirmed task ID for manual archiving in Cindy. Does not delete history or signal arbitrary processes.
